summary.text: Sherri Larkin is the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 44 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent John Lovick.
She has served on the Snohomish School District school board since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Larkin represents District 4 on the Snohomish School District school board; she assumed office in 2023 and her term ends in 2027.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary in second place, with 38.1 percent of the vote to Lovick's 61.9 percent.
